    <script type="text/javascript">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const DM_PLAYER_ID = 'xhojl';

        function fixDailymotionIframe(iframe) {
            let src = iframe.getAttribute('src');
            if (src && src.includes('dailymotion.com/embed/video/')) {
                let videoId = src.split('/embed/video/')[1].split('?')[0];
                let newSrc = 'https://geo.dailymotion.com/player/' + DM_PLAYER_ID + '.html?video=' + videoId;
                iframe.setAttribute('src', newSrc);
            }
        }

        // Cek semua iframe saat pertama kali halaman selesai dimuat
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(fixDailymotionIframe);

        // Pantau perubahan DOM (misal saat tab server diklik & iframe baru/src berubah)
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'src') {
                    fixDailymotionIframe(mutation.target);
                } else if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
                    mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
                        if (node.tagName === 'IFRAME') {
                            fixDailymotionIframe(node);
                        } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                            node.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(fixDailymotionIframe);
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['src']
        });
    });
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // Fungsi untuk menyuntikkan referrerpolicy ke iframe Rumble
        function fixRumbleIframes() {
            var iframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src*="rumble.com"]');
            iframes.forEach(function(iframe) {
                if (!iframe.getAttribute('referrerpolicy')) {
                    iframe.setAttribute('referrerpolicy', 'no-referrer');
                    // Reload iframe agar browser menerapkan aturan policy baru
                    var currentSrc = iframe.src;
                    iframe.src = currentSrc;
                }
            });
        }

        // Jalankan langsung saat DOM siap
        fixRumbleIframes();

        // Pantau jika tema memuat iframe secara dinamis (AJAX/Click)
        var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            fixRumbleIframes();
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
    </script>
